name: 91901 · Alpine, CA
findings: ZIP 91901 (Alpine) has 60 nonprofit organizations. 26 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 21 organizations.
Health care organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 91901 (Alpine) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 91901 (Alpine) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 70% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 23 organizations here; 25% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.text: 7 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
